title: TMZD Serialized Save Payload
description: Machine-readable schema for src/persistence/storage.js serializeState() output (SAVE_VERSION=2). Mirrors the JSDoc typedefs in src/persistence/serializedStateTypes.js and the Payload Contract Map in docs/ai/SYSTEMS/save.md. Loader is preserve-unknown=false; legacy saves with missing fields rely on restore defaults (see P4.7/P4.8).

attackWaveRemainingSec.description: Сколько sim-секунд осталось до следующей волны атаки на момент save. Относительная величина; writer — storage.js serializeAttackWaveSnapshot() (live-first через Game.getAttackWaveSnapshot()), reader — restoreFullState()/applyLoadedAttackWaveSnapshot(). null = legacy save / attack mode off / debug force-attack.

attackWaveActive.description: true, если игрок сохранился ВНУТРИ волны атаки. Без этого флага загрузка выключала волну и заново отсчитывала полный attackEverySec. Reader — restoreFullState()/applyLoadedAttackWaveSnapshot().

attackWaveRemainingActiveSec.description: Сколько sim-секунд осталось текущей активной волне (attackEndAt − now). Значимо только при attackWaveActive === true; clamped [0, attackDurationSec].

properties.$comment_dust_fragment_lifetime: dustEarnedLifetime + fragmentsAcquired — monotonic lifetime counters; survive partial AND full reset (see ADR in src/mechanics/achievements.js near ACHIEVEMENT_FAMILIES dust_master/fragment_collector); never decremented; only positive deltas via creditSiliconDust / addPlayerFragment seams

tanksCreatedByLevel.description: tank_building family counter — сколько танков ровно уровня L было создано (ключи — String(level)). Инкремент только из real-creation seam (game.js recordTankLevel с cause !== 'seed'); seed/restore не засчитываются.

playerChips.description: Whole-chip inventory (owned, uninstalled chips). Module-owned in src/ui/hangarChipsUI.js — note that the documented canonical owner `Game.State.getPlayerChips/setPlayerChips` does NOT exist in the codebase, so every mutation lands in the module's `_playerChipsFallback` and `state.playerChips` stays []. Writer — storage.js serializePlayerChips() (live-first via Game.HangarChipsUI.getPlayerChips(), fallback state.playerChips); reader — restoreFullState()/applySavedProgress() through Game.HangarChipsUI.setPlayerChips(payload.slice(), {reason:'restore'}) (unconditional, [] fallback; .slice() transfers ownership). Optional: legacy saves without this field restore an empty inventory.

playerFragments.description: Chip-shard inventory owned by src/ui/hangarChipsUI.js (module-owned, NOT part of runtime state). Array of {fragmentId, count}; writer — storage.js serializePlayerFragments() (live-first via Game.HangarChipsUI.getPlayerFragments(), fallback state.playerFragments); reader — restoreFullState()/applySavedProgress() through Game.HangarChipsUI.setPlayerFragments() (unconditional, [] fallback). Optional: legacy saves without this field restore an empty shard inventory.

siliconDust.description: Silicon dust (Кремниевая пыль) balance owned by src/ui/hangarChipsUI.js (module-owned, NOT part of runtime state). Writer — storage.js serializeSiliconDust() (live-first via Game.HangarChipsUI.getSiliconDust(), fallback state.siliconDust); reader — restoreFullState()/applySavedProgress() through Game.HangarChipsUI.setSiliconDust() (unconditional, 0 fallback; neutral write, does NOT bump dustEarnedLifetime). Optional: legacy saves without this field restore 0 dust.

techStudying.description: In-progress timed technology study owned by src/ui/hangarChipsUI.js. Shape {modId, elapsed, duration, acceleratedPct}; writer — storage.js serializeTechStudying() (live-first via Game.HangarChipsUI.getTechStudying(), fallback state.techStudying); reader — restoreFullState()/applySavedProgress() through Game.HangarChipsUI.setTechStudying() (unconditional, null fallback) which restarts the countdown timer. null = no study in progress / legacy save.

techFeedProgress.description: Per-tech fed-chip counters (instant-unlock path) owned by src/ui/hangarChipsUI.js. Keys are modId, values are fed chip counts; writer — storage.js serializeTechFeedProgress() (live-first via Game.HangarChipsUI.getTechFeedProgress(), fallback state.techFeedProgress); reader — restoreFullState()/applySavedProgress() through Game.HangarChipsUI.setTechFeedProgress() (unconditional, {} fallback). Optional: legacy saves without this field restore {}.

hangarCells.description: Persisted subset of the installed-chip grid owned by src/ui/hangarChipsUI.js (module-owned, NOT part of runtime state). Only {id, redSlots, yellowSlots} with {chipId, modIds, sourceComboKey, rotation, level} per slot are stored; derived fields (activeModifiers/uiState) are recomputed on load via Game.HangarChipsUI.setCells(). Optional: legacy saves without this field restore an empty grid.

shop.description: Yandex chip-bundle shop ledger block (solo-pipeline-yandex-vk batch#2 default-init, batch#3 schema). OPTIONAL at the top level: legacy saves from batch#1/#2 written before this field existed must still validate (backfill-safe). Inner fields are also optional so partial blobs (e.g. cloud-pulled with only entitlements) round-trip cleanly.

entitlements.description: Map purchaseToken -> entitlement record. Idempotency key for shopLedger.recordPurchase / applyBundle.

pendingDeliveries.description: Queue of purchaseTokens that survived the host call but were not credited yet (e.g. boot interrupted before applyBundle).

pendingExports.description: Optional outbox of ledger events buffered when Game.Config.Shop.ledgerExport.enabled is true. Absent when ledgerExport is disabled (the default).

lastSync.description: Unix-ms timestamp of the last successful CloudSave reconciliation. 0 means never synced.
